items.title: Citi names top infrastructure software stocks amid rising AI standards
items.summary: Investing.com -- Infrastructure software companies with tangible AI-driven growth and durable distribution advantages should be prioritized by investors as the burden of proof for artificial intelligence benefits has increased following a volatile third-quarter earnings season, according to a Citi note to clients.

items.title: Citi Names Top Application Software Stocks After Q3 Results
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi has updated its rankings for back office application software stocks following third-quarter results, prioritizing companies with clear acceleration potential and differentiated AI strategies. The firm continues to favor names with infrastructure-like or regulatory-driven value propositions while expressing caution on small and medium-sized business-exposed vendors facing top-of-funnel headwinds. BOX, NAVN, and ROP emerged as the top three picks in the updated rankings.

items.summary: Caterpillar's record backlog is stacked with data center orders stretching into 2030, yet the stock has cratered while Deere and PACCAR barely flinched. Is Wall Street punishing the wrong fear, and what will the next earnings call reveal?
